clue.text: The unstable nature of Eve ruins Creation

indicators.note: something unstable will not hold its shape, so the letters of the following words are shaken into a new order

explanation.surface: A theological remark that Eve's restless nature spoiled God's creation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The unstable nature of' rearranges EVE RUINS; the surface makes it sound like a comment on Eve's character.
explanation.definitionFit: The whole of creation is everything that exists, the cosmos.

clue.text: Nutcase heartlessly engineered overthrow

indicators.note: engineered means contrived, so the remaining letters are rearranged
heartlessly means the central letter of nutcase is removed

explanation.surface: A madman plotted a coup.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartlessly' takes C from the middle of NUTCASE, leaving NUTASE, which 'engineered' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: To unseat a ruler is to remove them from power.

clue.text: Redhead wearing smooth stockings is seen on the railway

parts.note: to iron is to smooth

indicators.note: wearing means the R is clothed by the stockings

parts.note: hose are stockings
the head of red is R

explanation.surface: A red-haired woman in silky stockings is spotted at the station.
explanation.definitionFit: An old nickname for a steam locomotive, found on railway tracks.

clue.text: Say to a Chinaman, "Perhaps this is a mail service"

parts.note: to express is to say
in cricket a Chinaman is a left-arm wrist-spin ball, a kind of bowled delivery; 'Perhaps' marks it as an example

explanation.surface: Telling a china dealer that this is how the post works.
explanation.walkthrough: A Chinaman is a cricket term for a left-arm unorthodox spin ball; cricket bowls 'deliveries'.
explanation.definitionFit: Fast dispatch of letters and parcels offered by the Post Office.

clue.text: Miss Lane interrupts drunkard, playing all on his own

indicators.note: interrupts means the name breaks into the word for drunkard

parts.note: a sot is a drunkard
Lois Lane is Superman's girlfriend

explanation.surface: Lois Lane cuts in on a drunk who is playing music alone.
explanation.definitionFit: A performer with no accompaniment plays alone.

clue.text: Make alterations only after promotion

indicators.note: after places the word for only behind the word for promotion

parts.note: an ad (advertisement) is a promotion
just means only, as in 'just one'

explanation.surface: Someone will only change things once they have been promoted.
explanation.definitionFit: To tweak or modify something is to change it slightly.

clue.text: Checker on board liner shows drawing ability

parts.note: a draughtsman is a piece in draughts, the game Americans call checkers
a liner is a passenger ship

explanation.surface: A ticket inspector aboard a cruise ship shows a talent for sketching.
explanation.walkthrough: Draughts is the British name for checkers.
explanation.definitionFit: Skill at technical drawing or sketching.

clue.text: America has time for convention

parts.note: America gives US
an age is a long time

explanation.surface: The USA makes room in its schedule for a conference.
explanation.definitionFit: Customary practice, established custom.

clue.text: Enid sits relaxed in a good state of order

indicators.note: relaxed means loosened, so the letters of Enid sits are rearranged

explanation.surface: Enid sits comfortably in a well-kept room.
explanation.definitionFit: Neatness: everything kept in its place.

clue.text: The harmony Bob found in wedlock

indicators.note: found in means the shilling sits inside the word for wedlock

parts.note: marriage is a union
a bob was a shilling, abbreviated s

explanation.surface: Bob discovered marital bliss.
explanation.walkthrough: A bob is the old British shilling, abbreviated s; 'Bob' looks like a man's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Singing in agreement, all on one note, is harmony.

clue.text: A vessel the banks rejected

indicators.note: rejected means the word for the banks is sent back, read from its end

parts.note: pools are shared stakes or funds, the banks in a game of chance

explanation.surface: A boat refused by the banks, perhaps for a loan.
explanation.definitionFit: A single-masted sailing boat is a kind of vessel.

clue.text: Help finish a hotel in the country

indicators.note: in places the run of pieces inside the word for the country

parts.note: land means a country, as in 'a foreign land'
the end is the finish
H is Hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Advice on assisting with the final stage of a country hotel.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for assisting someone with a task.

clue.text: The games his cattle disrupted

indicators.note: disrupted means thrown into disorder, so the letters of his cattle are rearranged

explanation.surface: A farmer's herd stampedes across the sports field during the games.
explanation.definitionFit: Track and field events form the core of sports meetings such as the Olympics.

clue.text: Rest after good harvest

indicators.note: after puts the word for rest behind the letter for good

parts.note: to lean is to rest, as against a wall

explanation.surface: Taking a break once a good harvest is in.
explanation.definitionFit: To gather leftover grain from a field, a gathering of crops.

clue.text: Cheers for one in the motor-racing team

indicators.note: in places the numeral inside the name of the team

parts.note: Prost Grand Prix was Alain Prost's Formula One team
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A toast raised for a member of a racing team.
explanation.walkthrough: The Prost team raced in Formula One from 1997 to 2001; 'for' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A drinking toast, Latin for 'may it benefit you', said when raising glasses.

clue.text: Writes down those against collecting rubbish

indicators.note: collecting means the word for those against gathers the rubbish inside it

parts.note: the noes are those voting against
tat is cheap rubbish

explanation.surface: Someone records which objectors are hoarding junk.
explanation.definitionFit: To record something in notation is to put it on paper.

clue.text: Initially, the painter depicts a bottom drawer

indicators.note: initially means only the first letter of the is used

parts.note: Henri Rousseau was a French painter

explanation.surface: A painter's picture of a bride-to-be's hoard.
explanation.walkthrough: A bottom drawer is the British term for the linen and clothes a bride collects before marriage.
explanation.definitionFit: A bride's collection of clothes and linen gathered for married life.

clue.text: Patio he and I constructed in Africa

indicators.note: constructed means built anew, so the letters of patio, he and I are rearranged

explanation.surface: Two people build a patio somewhere in Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: A country in the Horn of the continent, whose capital is Addis Ababa.

clue.text: Draw Ray demonstrating structural connector

parts.note: a tie is a drawn game
a beam is a ray of light

explanation.surface: An artist named Ray sketches a building joint.
explanation.definitionFit: A horizontal timber joining the feet of rafters holds a roof frame together.

clue.text: A good shot in Montana provides grub

indicators.note: in places the run of pieces inside the state abbreviation

parts.note: MT is the abbreviation for the US state of Montana
a go is a shot, an attempt

explanation.surface: A hunter's good shot in Montana provides dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: A fly larva, the soft white creature known as a grub.

clue.text: Hunter finding game with a stick

parts.note: nim is a game of taking matches from piles
a rod is a stick

explanation.surface: A huntsman spots his quarry while carrying a stick.
explanation.walkthrough: Nimrod is the mighty hunter of Genesis, used as a general word for one.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical huntsman's name stands for anyone keen on the chase.

clue.text: A primitive relic the lion damaged

indicators.note: damaged means broken up, so the letters of the lion are rearranged

explanation.surface: An ancient artefact mauled by a lion.
explanation.definitionFit: A Stone Age stone tool from the late prehistoric era.

clue.text: Exhausted by restraining mad king

indicators.note: restraining means the word by holds the king inside it

parts.note: by is taken as written
Lear is Shakespeare's mad king

explanation.surface: Worn out from holding back an insane monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Bleary-eyed from tiredness, with dim and watery vision.

clue.text: Foreigner starts to irritate reporter after question's ignored

indicators.note: starts to means the first letters of each of the following words are taken

explanation.surface: An overseas visitor begins to annoy a journalist after his question is brushed aside.
explanation.definitionFit: A national of a Middle Eastern country is a foreigner to a British solver.

clue.text: Overweight politician tucks into the drink

indicators.note: tucks into means the politician is put inside the drink

parts.note: ale is a drink
an MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A portly MP gets stuck into his beer.
explanation.definitionFit: A euphemism for large or well-padded in build.

clue.text: Member returns to cover schedules in plant

indicators.note: to cover means the reversed word goes round the word for schedules
returns means the word for member is turned to read backwards

parts.note: a leg is a limb, a member of the body
rounds are scheduled circuits, as in a doctor's rounds

explanation.surface: A club member goes back to deal with timetables at the factory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Member' looks like a club member but is a body part; 'returns' and 'to cover' work in turn, the reversal first.
explanation.definitionFit: A common weed of the daisy family, a garden plant.

clue.text: Seasoning on a bit of Italian sausage

parts.note: pepper is a seasoning

indicators.note: a bit of means only the first letter of Italian is used

explanation.surface: Adding spice to a slice of Italian sausage.
explanation.definitionFit: A spicy cured salami often found on pizzas.

clue.text: Scavenger having a bit of a laugh about money

indicators.note: about means the laugh goes round the money

parts.note: ha is one burst of laughter
the yen is Japanese money

explanation.surface: A scrounger chuckling over some cash.
explanation.walkthrough: The animal is known for its laughing call, which the surface plays on.
explanation.definitionFit: An African carnivore that feeds largely on carrion.

clue.text: A lemur gives an expression of agreement

definitions.meaning: a nocturnal Madagascan primate with a long thin finger
a nautical cry of 'yes, yes' to an order

explanation.surface: A lemur nodding along to whatever is said.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a Madagascan primate and a sailor's double yes acknowledging a command.

clue.text: Chinese style food joints to which you said you returned

parts.note: chops are joints of meat

indicators.note: returned means the pair of you-words is turned to read backwards

parts.note: ye is an old word for you

indicators.note: said means the second you is taken as the letter that sounds like it

parts.note: the word you sounds like the letter U

explanation.surface: A menu note about meat cuts you claimed to have sent back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'said' makes the second 'you' a single letter by sound, and 'returned' then flips the old and new forms of 'you' together.
explanation.definitionFit: A stir-fried dish of meat and vegetables from Chinese-American cooking.
